title: An operator invites a signup and the link is single use
description:
**Phase 2 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the operator queue story
- **Runs in parallel with:** the digest story
- **Unblocks:** paid enablement

---
The handoff from the anonymous funnel to the authenticated product, and the only place the two are joined.

The invitation email carries a single-use link that lands on sign-in. When they sign in with Google and create their organization, the organization records which waitlist signup it came from — which is what makes every survey answer queryable against a real tenant_id afterwards, and what lets the beta ask whether the teams people said they wanted match the teams they actually built.

Single use, and expiring, because the link is the gate on a queue whose rate is capped by how many provisioning sessions a week Anthus can run.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.text:
Feature: Waitlist triage

  Scenario: Inviting a signup issues a single-use link
    Given a confirmed waitlist signup in the queue
    When an operator invites them
    Then an invitation link is issued for that signup
    And the signup is marked invited

  Scenario: A used invitation link cannot be used again
    Given an invited waitlist signup whose link has been followed
    When the link is followed a second time
    Then it is refused

  Scenario: An expired invitation link is refused
    Given an invited waitlist signup whose link has expired
    When the link is followed
    Then it is refused
